title: Pasta Pomodorini
description: A simple Italian pasta with slow-roasted cherry tomatoes, olive oil, basil, and parmesan.

steps.instruction: Rinse and dry the cherry tomatoes, then toss with olive oil, sugar, salt, and pepper.
Spread tomatoes in a single layer on a baking sheet.
Roast for up to 5 hours, stirring and rotating the pan every 30 minutes, until concentrated and slightly dehydrated.
Cook pasta according to package instructions. Reserve some pasta water, then drain.
Return pasta to the pot and add roasted tomatoes.
Add olive oil, half the basil, and some parmesan cheese, then toss to combine.
Adjust consistency with reserved pasta water if needed.
Serve topped with remaining basil and more parmesan cheese.
